summary: Permit Axe contraction's migration-marked first opening of a canonical decision-tree v2 seat without granting later authority exceptions.

replay.detail: Replication and reader recognition apply stateless import authority checks. Content-equal disconnected imports converge to the bytewise lowest claim ID, with other immutable claims exposed as duplicate_openings witnesses and canonical_opening identifying the selected claim. Opening fields, including ordered legacy_trees entries, must match; claim IDs, writer and timestamps are ignored. Content-different openings fail closed with decision-import-opening-conflict naming the claim IDs. Only local admission requires an empty prior subject history.

schema.detail: The not-yet-published v2 opened schema gains optional import object. Its only admitted value is migration arn:lmig:axe:2026-10-08-decision-store-import; the existing non-empty legacy_trees locator is required for foreign-seat import opening. Seat-authored openings must omit import.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. Imported trees belong to the canonical seat, never the import writer. Shared opening selection and owner derivation govern admission, projection and the reader. Recognized content-equal opening duplicates do not grant later importer authority. Owner check and append share one transaction.

compatibility.detail: Prior immutable schemas refuse import as unknown. Old binaries given the new manifest may admit the generic object; their pre-exception decision reader refuses the foreign creation actor and cannot classify it as approval evidence. This is not a binary capability fence.

downtime.detail: Every fleet member must run this release before importer writes.

manual.detail: Upgrade all members first and require importer rollout preflight. Every daemon advertises decision-tree-import-opened=1. Local import-opened admission reuses the strict fleet feature barrier and returns member-version-unproven listing blockers until current members, external writers and configured peers advertise it. Only agent/dotfiles/axe-contraction may use this exception, only for opened under the canonical non-legacy seat subject. Remove the ARN, feature barrier and contraction exception after import reconciliation.

recovery.detail: Retained history requires upgraded readers even after the feature barrier reverses; refuse or upgrade old joiners. Conflicting openings have no decision-tree resolving claim or documented semantic repair primitive in this release. Stop conflicting import, preserve both immutable claims and require a separately authorized repair design; a seat status does not resolve the conflict. Reconcile imported trees before removing the temporary exception.
